model.name: Tiny DeepSeek V4 DSA indexer fixture

problem.summary: MindSpeed-LLM indexer loss overwrites saved sparse-attention padding
problem.trigger: Pinned CPU indexer loss with three queries, top-k width three, padded and fully populated indices, an aliased saved view and independent gather output and gradient references.
problem.expected: The captured arrays match the independent fixture reference exactly.
problem.observed: Baseline differs on 6/34 paired elements. Candidate matches all 34.

cause.summary: In-place sanitization replaces padding index -1 in the caller-owned tensor. A saved sparse-attention view observes those entries as valid indices.

repair.summary: Sanitize a new tensor for the indexer loss and preserve the caller-owned padding.

validation.scope: Pinned CPU indexer loss with three queries, top-k width three, padded and fully populated indices, an aliased saved view and independent gather output and gradient references.
checks: Both arms have zero nonfinite elements.
remaining: A synthetic CPU gather consumes the retained view and checks its output and gradient. Native sparse attention, context parallelism and model training were outside this comparison.

notes: Comparison is scoped to the named CPU fixture.

repairs.title: Mooncake prefill handoff can retire a page needed by decode

title.en: Mooncake prefill handoff can retire a page needed by decode

summary.en: Baseline differs on 7/1553 paired elements. Candidate matches all 1553.

problem.summary: Mooncake prefill handoff can retire a page needed by decode
problem.trigger: Pinned CPU scheduler, cache manager and block-pool paths at a 512-token window and 128-token pages. Tests use 1,022–1,024 prompt tokens with single-token and full-attention controls.
problem.expected: The captured arrays match the independent fixture reference exactly.
problem.observed: Baseline differs on 7/1553 paired elements. Candidate matches all 1553.

cause.summary: On sliding-window cache groups, Prefill computes the final prompt token even though Decode replays it. This advances retention beyond the history needed by that replay.

repair.summary: Recognize sliding-window cache groups and use the existing handoff that leaves the final prompt token to Decode.

validation.scope: Pinned CPU scheduler, cache manager and block-pool paths at a 512-token window and 128-token pages. Tests use 1,022–1,024 prompt tokens with single-token and full-attention controls.
checks: Both arms have zero nonfinite elements.
remaining: CPU fixture substitutes request metadata, FIFO storage and synthetic page payloads. Transport, full-model outputs and accelerator behavior are outside the comparison.

notes: Comparison is scoped to the named CPU fixture.
